iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: ISW reports Iran is asserting Hormuz controlled transit authority and seeking vessel approval powers while Trump weighs resumed strikes versus a deal. Negotiating channels remain open, but incompatible demands and blockade pressure keep the conventional war track imminent.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON

turkey.name: TURKEY

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan remains critical on standing PLA military buildup and regular activity around Taiwan. Search surfaced older drill coverage and no fresh blockade step or new large exercise in the current window.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE

Ukraine deep-strike activity against military-industrial and energy-linked targets also continues.

sudan.name: SUDAN
